import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Mint {
        long x;
        static long MOD;

        Mint() { x = 0; }
        Mint(long _x) {
            x = _x >= 0 ? _x % MOD : _x % MOD + MOD;
        }

        Mint pow(long b) {
            if (b == 0) return new Mint(1);
            Mint tmp = this.pow(b / 2);
            return (b % 2 == 1) ? tmp.mul(tmp).mul(this) : tmp.mul(tmp);
        }

        Mint inv() {
            return this.pow(MOD - 2);
        }

        Mint add(Mint b) { return new Mint((x + b.x) % MOD); }
        Mint sub(Mint b) { return new Mint((x - b.x + MOD) % MOD); }
        Mint mul(Mint b) { return new Mint((x * b.x) % MOD); }
        Mint div(Mint b) { return this.mul(b.inv()); }

        Mint addEq(Mint b) { x = (x + b.x) % MOD; return this; }
        Mint subEq(Mint b) { x = (x - b.x + MOD) % MOD; return this; }
        Mint mulEq(Mint b) { x = (x * b.x) % MOD; return this; }
        Mint divEq(Mint b) { x = (x * b.inv().x) % MOD; return this; }

        boolean equals(Mint b) { return x == b.x; }
        boolean notEquals(Mint b) { return x != b.x; }
    }

    static long[][] comb;
    static Mint[] f, g;
    static Mint[][][] dp, dpc;

    static long sumRange(long l, long r) {
        if (l > r) return 0;
        return (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    }

    static void buildComb(int n) {
        comb = new long[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = comb[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long MOD = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        Mint.MOD = MOD;

        buildComb((int)600 - 1);

        f = new Mint[(int)m + 1];
        g = new Mint[(int)m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            f[i] = new Mint(0);
            g[i] = new Mint(0);
        }

        f[0] = new Mint(0);
        g[0] = new Mint(1);
        f[1] = new Mint(0);
        g[1] = new Mint(2);
        
        for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) {
            Mint tmp = new Mint(0);
            Mint tmpc = new Mint(0);
            for (int l = 0; l < i; l++) {
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                long sumLR = sumRange(1, l) + sumRange(1, r);
                tmp = tmp.add(g[l].mul(g[r]).mul(new Mint(sumLR)).mul(new Mint(comb[i - 1][l])));
                tmp = tmp.add(f[l].mul(g[r]).add(f[r].mul(g[l])).mul(new Mint(comb[i - 1][l])).mul(new Mint(i + 1)));
                tmpc = tmpc.add(g[l].mul(g[r]).mul(new Mint(i + 1)).mul(new Mint(comb[i - 1][l])));
            }
            f[i] = tmp;
            g[i] = tmpc;
        }

        dp = new Mint[(int)n + 1][(int)m + 1][2];
        dpc = new Mint[(int)n + 1][(int)m + 1][2];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = new Mint(0);
                    dpc[i][j][k] = new Mint(0);
                }
            }
        }

        dpc[0][0][0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                if (j > i) continue;

                dpc[i][j][0] = dpc[i - 1][j][0].add(dpc[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    dpc[i][j][1] = dpc[i][j][1].add(g[k].mul(new Mint(comb[j][k])).mul(dpc[i - k][j - k][0]));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                if (j > i) continue;

                dp[i][j][0] = dp[i - 1][j][0].add(dp[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    Mint term1 = f[k].mul(new Mint(comb[j][k])).mul(dpc[i - k][j - k][0]);
                    Mint term2 = dp[i - k][j - k][0].mul(g[k]).mul(new Mint(comb[j][k]));
                    dp[i][j][1] = dp[i][j][1].add(term1.add(term2));
                }
            }
        }

        pw.println(dp[(int)n][(int)m][0].add(dp[(int)n][(int)m][1]).x);
        pw.close();
    }
}
